about_the_game:
The highly anticipated third installment of the pixel art monster sprite collection by pixel artist Mokemo. This pack includes 20 unique monsters, such as parasitic creatures, bizarre machines, spirits trapped by curses, and stuffed animals with a will of their own. Whether as formidable foes standing in the player's way or as trusty allies, incorporate these charming monsters into your work and breathe new life into your creations.

［Mokemo Factory MONSTER PIXEL PACK Vol.3］Contents

2D Stamps: 20 types
Color Variations: 3 colors for each monster
Outline: 3 types: none, black, and color
Image Size: 48x192 (4 animation patterns)
